summary: Practise hazard scanning, space management and vehicle checks in defensive driving training. Explore the course and its workplace applications.
lede: Defensive driving training helps fleet and professional drivers, delivery drivers and supervisors spot hazards and choose safer actions on work journeys. Learners practise SIPDE scanning, manage following distance, speed and lane position for changing conditions, and complete vehicle-readiness checks while making decisions about fatigue, distraction and driver-assistance system limits.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who drive for work or oversee work-related driving and need practical methods for reducing exposure to road hazards.
prerequisites: Routine driving experience and a current driving licence are recommended. No coding or specialist road-safety knowledge is required. Practical on-road driving is not assumed; any live-vehicle activity depends on venue, vehicle availability and applicable licensing and insurance arrangements.
